reviews.title: Love these fans
reviews.comment: While I do wish Asus would make these daisy chained its nothing a hub cant get around. These fans are 28mm thick and run quiet. The subtle edge lighting with the ring around the blades adds just the right touch of light and gives then entire PC that Tron look. I am sure these fans will last me until they release a magnetic link version like their ROG fans that are impossible to find.
reviews.author: MetalFan

reviews.title: Reduced overall temperature by nearly 50%
reviews.comment: I need a new case fans for my ASUS desktop PC and decided to go with these lights because I was sick of replacing my other fans too often because they were too cheap. Upon installing just two out of the three fans, I saw nearly a 50% reduction in overall temperature inside my tower. Because these lights are compatible with Aurora Sync, I can control the lighting of the fans a variety of different ways such as the color, the intensity of them, the patterns if any. They really do make the possibilities unless. Fans are super quiet and really easy to install. They come with 4 small screws for each fan. I was concerned the lighting might be too bright but I am happy to say that it's actually just perfect.
reviews.author: DragonFire1024

reviews.title: A good fan as it should be
reviews.comment: This little fan is sweet! Pretty quiet, looks cool, does it's job. Would buy again.
reviews.author: Mike

reviews.title: Perfect match for Asus case
reviews.comment: I got the ASUS A31 Plus case for my new build and it came with 4 fans pre-installed. A google search said that these ASUS Prime fans would not match what came with the case but I decided to go ahead and try. Perfect match for what is in the case, and they look great. Easy to install and hook up, plenty bright, and easy to control with whichever is your favourite RGB controller app. They keep my pc cool even during intense gaming and are super quiet.
reviews.author: Ryan V

reviews.title: Good
reviews.comment: Very fast shipping to opposite side of the world (4 days) A bit expensive for case fan but since I have ASUS case, this make my build perfect and also this shop has the cheapest price I can find.
